map.输入：肌肉=腘绳肌(紧张度 1.2)、等级=中级(保持 30 秒/3 组/每周:
Input: muscle=hamstrings (tightness 1.2), level=intermediate (hold 30 seconds/3 sets/4 times a week), phase=cool-down (static-based, factor 1.0).
Static hold=round(30×1.2×1.0)=36 seconds/set; tightness >1.1 and not a warm-up → sets +1=4 sets.
Session static subtotal=36×4=144 seconds; no dynamic/PNF (cool-down phase) → session total=144 seconds.
Weekly total=144×4/60=9.6 minutes.
Conclusion: the intermediate cool-down plan for the hamstrings is a 36-second static hold × 4 sets (about 2.4 minutes) per session, about 9.6 minutes total across 4 sessions a week.

map.一般 15–60 秒/组、2–4 组有效改善柔韧；本工具按等级(初 15/中 3: Generally 15–60 seconds per set and 2–4 sets effectively improves flexibility; this tool derives it by multiplying the level (beginner 15 / intermediate 30 / advanced 45 seconds) by the muscle tightness and the phase factor. Tight muscle groups get an extra set, and the PNF phase adds an isometric hold of about 1.2×.
map.训练前适合静态拉伸吗？: Is static stretching suitable before training?
map.训练前更推荐动态拉伸激活（本工具热身阶段以动态为主），静态长时间拉伸可能短暂降低: Dynamic stretching activation is more recommended before training (this tool's warm-up phase is mainly dynamic), as long static stretching may briefly reduce explosive power; static/PNF is better after training or in dedicated flexibility training.
